file: d854664d8k_htm.html Document 16 - RAW XML: d854664d8k_htm.xml </DOCUMENT> </SEC-DOCUMENT> DOCUMENT d854664dex101.htm EX-10.1 2 d854664dex101.htm EX-10.1 EX-10.1 Exhibit 10.1 Execution Version REFINANCING AMENDMENT, INCREMENTAL ASSUMPTION AGREEMENT AND AMENDMENT NO. 4 REFINANCING AMENDMENT, INCREMENTAL ASSUMPTION AGREEMENT AND AMENDMENT NO. 4, dated as of September 26, 2025 (this “ Agreement ”), among Coherent Corp., a Pennsylvania corporation (the “ Borrower ”), each other Loan Party (as defined in the Credit Agreement referred to below) listed on the signature pages hereof, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent (the “ Administrative Agent ”) for the Lenders (as defined in the Credit Agreement) and as Collateral Agent (as defined in the Credit Agreement), and the other parties party thereto. Unless otherwise defined herein, capitalized terms are used herein as defined in the Credit Agreement. W I T N E S S E T H WHEREAS, reference is hereby made to the Credit Agreement, dated as of July 1, 2022 (as amended by Amendment No. 1, dated as of March 31, 2023, Amendment No. 2, dated as of April 2, 2024, Amendment No. 3, dated as of January 2, 2025, and as further amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time prior to the date hereof, the “ Credit Agreement ” and as amended pursuant to this Agreement, the “Amended Credit Agreement ”), among the Borrower, the Lenders party thereto from time to time, the Issuing Banks party thereto from time to time, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent for the Lenders and as Collateral Agent, and the other parties party thereto from time to time; WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 2.23(c) of the Credit Agreement, the Borrower has requested Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments in an aggregate amount equal to $350,000,000 (the “2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments ” and Loans pursuant to such 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments, the “ 2025 Replacement Revolving Loans ”; and the Lenders with 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments and/or 2025 Replacement Revolving Loans, the “ 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Lenders ”) to replace all of the Revolving Facility Commitments in effect immediately prior to effectiveness of this Agreement (the “Initial Revolving Facility Commitments ”) upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein; WHEREAS, immediately after giving effect to the 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments, pursuant to Section 2.21 of the Credit Agreement, the Borrower has requested Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments to increase the 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments to an aggregate amount equal to $700,000,000 (the “ 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments ” and, together with the 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments, the “ 2025 Revolving Facility Commitments ”; the Loans pursuant to such 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments, the “ 2025 Incremental Revolving Loans ” and, together with the 2025 Replacement Revolving Loans, the “ 2025 Revolving Loans ”; and the Lenders with 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments and/or 2025 Incremental Revolving Loans, the “ 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Lenders ” and, together with the 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Lenders, the “2025 Revolving Facility Lenders ”), upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein, and immediately following the consummation of the transactions contemplated by this recital and the preceding recital, the Revolving Facility Commitments shall be comprised of the 2025 Revolving Facility Commitments and the 2025 Revolving Facility Lenders will provide such 2025 Revolving Facility Commitments to the Borrower; WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 2.21 of the Credit Agreement, the Borrower has requested Incremental Term A Loan Commitments in the aggregate principal amount of $1,250,000,000 (the “ 2025 Incremental Term A Loans ”; the commitments in respect of such 2025 Incremental Term A Loans, the “ 2025 Incremental Term A Commitments ”; and the Lenders with 2025 Incremental Term A Commitments and/or 2025 Incremental Term A Loans, the “ 2025 Incremental Term A Lenders ”) in the form of Other Incremental Term A Loans under the Credit Agreement, and the Borrower, the Administrative Agent and the 2025 Incremental Term A Lenders have agreed, upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein, that the 2025 Incremental Term A Lenders will provide such 2025 Incremental Term A Loans to the Borrower; WHEREAS, pursuant to Sections 2.21, 2.23 and 9.08(e) of the Credit Agreement, the Borrower, the Administrative Agent and the Lenders party hereto wish to make certain amendments to the Credit Agreement that are necessary to provide for the establishment of the 2025 Revolving Facility Commitments and the 2025 Incremental Term A Commitments and the incurrence of the 2025 Revolving Loans and 2025 Incremental Term A Loans; WHEREAS, immediately after giving effect to the 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments, the establishment of the 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments, the incurrence of the 2025 Incremental Term A Loans and the Term Loan B Prepayment (as defined below), the Borrower, each 2025 Revolving Facility Lender and each 2025 Incremental Term A Lender (collectively constituting the Required Lenders under the Credit Agreement) wish to make certain other modifications to the Credit Agreement (as amended by this Agreement) pursuant to Section 9.08(b) of the Credit Agreement; WHEREAS, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., BofA Securities, Inc., Citizens Bank, N.A., Credit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank, HSBC Securities (USA) Inc., Mizuho Bank, Ltd., Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc., MUFG Bank, Ltd. and PNC Capital Markets LLC (or any of its affiliates as so designated by it to act in such capacity) have been appointed and will act as joint lead arrangers and joint bookrunners for the 2025 Revolving Facility Commitments and 2025 Incremental Term A Loans (in such capacity, the “Lead Arrangers ”); NOW, THEREFORE, the parties hereto agree as follows: SECTION 1. 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments . Subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein, each 2025 Revolving Facility Lender listed on Annex I hereto agrees to provide to the Borrower, on the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date (as defined below), 2025 Revolving Facility Commitments in an aggregate principal amount equal to the amount set forth under the heading “2025 Revolving Facility Commitments” opposite such 2025 Revolving Facility Lender’s name on Annex I hereto. An aggregate amount equal to $350,000,000 of the 2025 Revolving Facility Commitments, which shall be held by each 2025 Revolving Facility Lender on a pro rata basis, shall constitute Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments for the purpose of Section 2.23(c) of the Credit Agreement that replace the Initial Revolving Facility Commitments and shall have the terms described in Section 6 below. Each party hereto acknowledges that this Agreement shall (i) be deemed to be a Refinancing Amendment for all purposes under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents and (ii) constitute the written notice required to be delivered by the Borrower to the Administrative Agent pursuant to Section 2.23(c) of the Credit Agreement. SECTION 2. 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments . Subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein, each 2025 Revolving Facility Lender listed on Annex I hereto with a 2025 Revolving Facility Commitment agrees to provide to the Borrower, on the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date, 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments in an aggregate principal amount equal to its pro rata share of $350,000,000. The 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments shall constitute Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments for the purpose of Section 2.21 of the Credit Agreement and shall be subject to the following terms and conditions: (a) Terms Generally . For all purposes under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents, the 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments shall be deemed to 2 be Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments incurred under the Credit Agreement and shall have the same terms as the 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments. (b) Incremental Revolving Facility Lenders . Each 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Lender acknowledges and agrees that it shall become a “Lender” under, and for all purposes of, the Amended Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents, and shall be subject to and bound by the terms thereof, and shall perform all the obligations of and shall have all rights of a Lender thereunder. (c) Credit Agreement Governs . Except as set forth in this Agreement, the 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments shall otherwise be subject to the provisions of the Amended Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents. (d) Acknowledgement . Each party hereto acknowledges that (i) each 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Lender constitutes an Incremental Revolving Facility Lender, (ii) this Agreement shall be deemed to be an Incremental Assumption Agreement for all purposes under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents and (iii) this Agreement shall constitute the written notice required to be delivered by the Borrower to the Administrative Agent pursuant to Section 2.21 of the Credit Agreement. SECTION 3. Administrative Matters Related to the 2025 Revolving Facility Commitment and Loans . (a) Notwithstanding the (x) replacement of the Initial Revolving Facility Commitments with the 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments and (y) the increase of the 2025 Replacement Revolving Facility Commitments with the 2025 Incremental Revolving Facility Commitments, in each case, on the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date, for administrative convenience, (A) Letters of Credit outstanding under the Credit Agreement immediately prior to the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date (if any) shall remain outstanding and be deemed to utilize 2025 Revolving Facility Commitments after the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date and (B) Revolving Loans (if any) outstanding under the Credit Agreement immediately prior to the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date shall remain outstanding and be deemed to utilize 2025 Revolving Facility Commitments after the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date. (b) Upon the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date, each 2025 Revolving Facility Lender will automatically and without further act be deemed to have assumed a portion of participations under the Credit Agreement in the outstanding Letters of Credit listed on Annex III hereto such that, after giving effect thereto, the percentage of the aggregate outstanding participations under the Credit Agreement in Letters of Credit held by each 2025 Revolving Facility Lender will equal the percentage of the aggregate 2025 Revolving Facility Commitments of all 2025 Revolving Facility Lenders represented by such 2025 Revolving Facility Lender’s 2025 Revolving Facility Commitment after giving effect to this Agreement. SECTION 4. 2025 Incremental Term A Loans . Subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein, each 2025 Incremental Term A Lender listed on Annex I hereto agrees to make to the Borrower, on the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date, 2025 Incremental Term A Loans in an aggregate principal amount equal to the amount set forth under the heading “2025 Incremental Term A Commitments” opposite such 2025 Incremental Term A Lender’s name on Annex I hereto. The 2025 Incremental Term A Loans shall constitute Other Incremental Term A Loans for the purpose of Section 2.21 of the Credit Agreement and a new Class of Term Loans and shall be subject to the following terms and conditions: 3 (a) Terms Generally . For all purposes under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents, the 2025 Incremental Term A Loans shall be deemed to be Incremental Term A Loans incurred under the Credit Agreement, bearing interest at the Adjusted Term SOFR Rate (as defined in the Amended Credit Agreement) or ABR Loans, and having the terms set forth in the Amended Credit Agreement for such 2025 Incremental Term A Loans. (b) Proposed Borrowing . This Agreement represents a request by the Borrower to borrow 2025 Incremental Term A Loans from the 2025 Incremental Term A Lenders on the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date as set forth on the applicable Borrowing Request delivered by the Borrower under the Credit Agreement. (c) 2025 Incremental Term A Lenders . Each 2025 Incremental Term A Lender acknowledges and agrees that it shall become a “Lender” under, and for all purposes of, the Amended Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents, and shall be subject to and bound by the terms thereof, and shall perform all the obligations of and shall have all rights of a Lender thereunder. (d) Credit Agreement Governs . Except as otherwise set forth in this Agreement, the 2025 Incremental Term A Loans shall be subject to the provisions of the Amended Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents. (e) Use of Proceeds . The proceeds of the 2025 Incremental Term A Loans will be used by the Borrower to (i) repay in full the outstanding principal amount of Initial Term A Loans and any unpaid interest and fees related thereto, (ii) make a voluntary prepayment of Term B-2 Loans outstanding on the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date and (iii) for general corporate purposes (including for working capital and fees and expenses in connection with the transactions in connection with this Agreement). (f) Acknowledgement . Each party hereto acknowledges that (i) each 2025 Incremental Term A Lender constitutes an Incremental Term Lender, (ii) this Agreement shall be deemed to be an Incremental Assumption Agreement for all purposes under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents and (iii) this Agreement shall constitute the written notice required to be delivered by the Borrower to the Administrative Agent pursuant to Section 2.21 of the Credit Agreement. SECTION 5. Notice; Satisfactory Form . The Administrative Agent agrees that upon the occurrence of the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date it shall promptly notify each Lender as to the effectiveness of this Agreement. The Administrative Agent acknowledges that this Agreement (including all Schedules and Annexes hereto) is in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to it. SECTION 6. Amendment of the Credit Agreement . (a) On and as of the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date upon the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions set forth in Section 6: (i) the Credit Agreement shall be amended, without additional consent or approval of any other Lender, to delete the stricken text (indicated textually in the same manner as the following example: stricken text ) and to add the double-underlined text (indicated textually in the same manner as the following example: double-underlined text) as set forth in the pages of the Credit Agreement attached as Exhibit A hereto; 4 (ii) Schedule 1.01 (Letter of Credit Individual Sublimits) shall be amended and restated in its entirety as set forth on Annex II hereto; (iii) Schedule 2.01 (Commitments) to the Credit Agreement shall be amended by supplementing such schedule with the information contained in Annex I hereto; (iv) Schedules 3.04 (Government Approvals), 3.08(a) (Subsidiaries), 3.09(a) (Litigation), 3.16 (Environmental Matters), 3.20 (Insurance), 3.21 (Intellectual Property),6.01 (Indebtedness), 6.02(a) (Liens), 6.04 (Investments), 6.07 (Transactions with Affiliates) and 9.01 (Notice Information) to the Credit Agreement shall be amended and restated in their entirety as set forth on Annex IV hereto; (v) A new Schedule 6.09 (Collateral Suspension Period) is added to the Credit Agreement in the form of Annex V hereto; and (vi) Exhibit B (Compliance Certificate) to the Credit Agreement shall be amended and restated in its entirety as set forth on Annex VI hereto. SECTION 7. Conditions to Effectiveness and Funding . (a) The effectiveness of this Agreement is subject to the satisfaction or waiver of each of the following conditions (the date on which such conditions shall have been so satisfied or waived, the “ Amendment No. 4 Effective Date ”): (i) The Administrative Agent shall have received a counterpart of this Agreement, executed and delivered by a duly authorized officer of the Borrower, each other Loan Party, each 2025 Revolving Facility Lender and each 2025 Incremental Term A Lender (collectively, the 2025 Revolving Facility Lenders and the 2025 Incremental Term A Lenders constituting Required Lenders and all Revolving Facility Lenders and all Term A Lenders), each Issuing Bank and the Administrative Agent. (ii) The Administrative Agent or the applicable Lender shall have received, at least three Business Days prior to the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date, (i) if any Loan Party qualifies as a “legal entity customer” under 31 C.F.R. § 1010.230 (the “Beneficial Ownership Regulation ”), a certification regarding beneficial ownership as required by the Beneficial Ownership Regulation with respect to such Borrower, to the extent reasonably requested in writing by any 2025 Revolving Facility Lender or 2025 Incremental Term A Lender at least ten Business Days prior to the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date and (ii) all other documentation and information with respect to any Loan Party that is required by regulatory authorities under applicable “know your customer” and anti-money laundering rules and regulations, including without limitation the USA PATRIOT Act, to the extent reasonably requested in writing by any 2025 Revolving Facility Lender or 2025 Incremental Term A Lender at least ten Business Days prior to the Amendment No. 4 Effective Date. On September 26, 2025, Visa Inc. (the “Company”) announced new conversion rates applicable to the Company’s class B-1 and B-2 common stock resulting from its September 25, 2025 deposit of $500 million into the U.S. litigation escrow account previously established under the Company’s U.S. retrospective responsibility plan (the “Plan”). Under the terms of the Plan, the conversion rate applicable to the Company’s class B-1 common stock decreased from 1.5609 to 1.5549 and the conversion rate applicable to the Company's class B-2 common stock decreased from 1.5342 to 1.5223, in each case effective as of September 25, 2025. The conversion rate adjustments have the same effect on earnings per share as repurchasing the Company’s class A common stock. Therefore the as-converted class B-1 common stock share count was reduced by approximately 28,885 from 7,547,381 to 7,518,496 and the as-converted class B-2 common stock share count was reduced by approximately 1,437,724 from 184,625,546 to 183,187,821. The deposit and conversion rate adjustment calculations were conducted in accordance with the Company’s certificate of incorporation currently in effect using the volume-weighted average price over the 5-day pricing period from September 18, 2025 through September 24, 2025.
